caption_L1: Here a bar chart is called Number of immigrants to Sweden in 2019 , by age group. The y-axis plots Number of immigrants while the x-axis plots Year.
caption_L2L3: Immigrants aged 25-34 are the largest group, followed by 15-24 and then 35-44. . Over 85s are the lowest group. Generally immigration decrease by age group after age 34. 35K people aged 25-34 went to Sweden in 2019 compared to about 3K in the 55-64 age group.
